alex: Heads-up — found a reproducible bundler/edge SDK combo that breaks auth retries + types when using default import in ESM apps. Minimal repro attached.

maria: ugh, details? which bundler + runtime?

alex: repro steps (super short):
1. npx create-vite@latest sample-app --template react-ts
2. npm i @redwood/inference-js (our SDK dev build)
3. in src/main.tsx: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` (default import)
4. build for edge (vite SSR or cloudflare pages) and run — requests intermittently 401 then retry loops, and TS complains about default export types.

logs (from CF worker):
```
AuthError: missing token
at fetchToken (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.js:45:21)
at callApi (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.js:120:15)
Retrying request (attempt 2) \nAuthError: retry token fetch returned null
```

tyler: does this happen with named import (`import { RedwoodClient } from ...`)?

alex: good q — using named import bypasses the runtime 401 loop. Seems tied to how bundlers transform default import -> interop wrapper. Vite SSR (esbuild) mangles the `default` surface and our `exports.default` vs `exports` shape differs at runtime.

jen: so it's an ESM/CJS interop thing. Any repro for webpack/rollup?

alex: yes — rollup + vite differ. Quick matrix:
- Vite dev: works (optimizeDeps allows ESM)
- Vite build (SSR): fails when `ssr.noExternal` is not set
- Rollup: fails unless `@rollup/plugin-commonjs` is configured with `include` for node_modules
- Webpack: usually ok if `module.rules` handles .mjs, but some configs fallback to CJS and then default import gets wrapped

maria: typing error symptoms?

alex: TS shows: `Namespace has no default export` or `Type 'typeof import(\"...\")' has no call signatures` depending on tsconfig.moduleResolution. In some projects folks workaround with `import Redwood = require('@redwood/inference-js')` which is gross.

tyler: workaround for app teams?

alex: recommended workarounds we've validated:
- Use named imports: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'`
- Vite: add to vite.config.ts: `ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] }` and/or `optimizeDeps.include: ['@redwood/inference-js']`
- Rollup: enable commonjs plugin for node_modules or add `namedExports` mapping for the sdk dist file
- TS: set `esModuleInterop: true` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true` in tsconfig as a shim

ci-bot: build-failure reported for sample-app-ci (#413) — failing test: auth-flow-integration.ts (flake)

jen: we should ship a short note in SDK migration docs and add a test matrix for bundlers. Also maybe change package exports to add a small CJS shim?

alex: open questions for platform: can we publish an additional `exports` entrypoint specifically flagged `import` vs `require`? Right now package.json has `main` -> cjs, `module` -> esm, plus `types` -> dist/index.d.ts. But some bundlers still end up loading cjs due to `exports` resolution.

tyler: alternative: ship a tiny `index.mjs` that re-exports named symbols explicitly (no default) to avoid interop wrappers. That should make Vite/rollup load clean ESM shape.

maria: can you attach a minimal repro repo? I'll take a look and try the `ssr.noExternal` tweak.

alex: pushing a tiny repro gist in a sec — main failing branch: `vite-ssr-default-import` (will paste link). Quick repro commands in case you want to run locally:
```

cd repro-vite-edge-sdk
npm i
npm run build:ssr
node ./dist/server/entry.js # or deploy to CF pages
# observe 401/retry logs
```
